standard_prerequisites.name: The structure of a scheme locally quasi-finite over a field as a disjoint union of spectra of Artinian local algebras

core_obligations: Reduce to the discreteness test: base change the whole composite to the spectrum of a field and use that local quasi-finiteness is preserved by base change, so it suffices to show that the space of the base-changed source is discrete (proof lines 5041-5048)

Cover the middle stack: the middle stack is quasi-DM, so it admits a scheme surjective flat locally quasi-finite over it; that scheme is locally quasi-finite over the field and hence has discrete space (proof lines 5049-5060)

Descend discreteness: the base change of the source along that covering is surjective flat and of finite presentation over the source, so its space maps surjectively and openly onto the space of the source, and it suffices to show the former is discrete (proof lines 5061-5066)

Compute on the pieces: the covering scheme decomposes into spectra of Artinian local algebras, and discreteness of each piece reduces to the discreteness of the fibre of the original morphism over the corresponding residue field point, which is the hypothesis (proof lines 5067-5078)
proof_roadmap: 把 X → Y → Z 沿 Spec(k) → Z 基变换；只需证 |X_k| 离散。
Y_k 准 DM ⇒ 存在概型 V 满平坦局部拟有限映到 Y_k ⇒ V 在 k 上局部拟有限 ⇒ |V| 离散。
V ×_{Y_k} X_k → X_k 满平坦局部有限表现 ⇒ 其空间到 |X_k| 满且开；只需证 |V ×_{Y_k} X_k| 离散。
V 是 Artin 局部 k-代数谱之并 ⇒ 只需每片 |Spec(k_i) ×_Y X| 离散，这正是 X → Y 局部拟有限的假设。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a composite of locally quasi-finite morphisms of algebraic stacks is locally quasi-finite (author lemma at source lines 5036-5039, label lemma-composition-locally-quasi-finite). The proof (source lines 5041-5079) reduces to the discreteness test over a field, covers the middle stack by a scheme using the quasi-DM characterization, descends discreteness along the surjective flat finitely presented base change, and computes the pieces through the decomposition of a scheme of dimension zero over a field into Artinian local spectra (proof lines 5041-5078). The covering of the middle stack and the piece-by-piece computation are the substance. H3.
